rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic revenue management software that uses competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rents. Software providers and other coordinators may not use such software to coordinate pricing among competing landlords.
citation_aliases: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent Act
rules.quoted_span: The FAIR Act prohibits residential rental property owners from using algorithmic revenue management software that collects or processes competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rental prices.
rules.effective_date_note: Document states the Act takes effect July 1, 2027.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic revenue management software using nonpublic competitor data
rules.penalty: AG complaint portal; existing remedies under the New Jersey Antitrust Act preserved
rules.exemptions: Spreadsheets requiring human analysis, publicly available rent estimation tools, traditional real estate listing databases, and government-administered affordable housing programs are not prohibited.
rules.interaction: May preempt Jersey City and Hoboken ordinances once effective.
rules.conflict_note: May preempt local algorithmic rent-setting ordinances in Jersey City and Hoboken; flag for review.

parsed.doc_summary: Day Pitney alert on NJ's FAIR Act (P.L.2026, c.43), signed July 20, 2026, banning algorithmic rent-setting using nonpublic competitor data, effective July 1, 2027.
